Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description: Represents a scheduled exam or reminder.

examType.description: Type of exam scheduled (e.g., Workplace, Equipment).

reminderSet.description: Indicates whether a reminder is set for this schedule.

Training.title: Training
Training.description: Represents a training module or record.

id.description: Unique identifier for the training record.

description.description: A short description of the training.

category.description: Category of the training (e.g., Safety, Equipment Operation).

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product or service that can be sold, synced from Stripe.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product (from Stripe).

active.description: Whether the product is currently available for purchase.

name.description: The product's name, meant to be displayable to the customer.

description.description: The product's description, meant to be displayable to the customer.

role.description: The role to assign to the user upon purchasing this product. This maps to an application-specific plan.

images.description: A list of up to 8 URLs of images for this product, meant to be displayable to the customer.

metadata.description: A metadata object for storing plan-specific attributes like user or mine limits.

Price.title: Price
Price.description: Represents the price of a product, synced from Stripe.

id.description: Unique identifier for the price (from Stripe).

productId.description: The ID of the product this price belongs to.

active.description: Whether the price can be used for new purchases.

description.description: A brief description of the price.

unit_amount.description: The unit amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents).

type.description: Whether the price is for a one-time purchase or a recurring subscription.

interval.description: The frequency at which a subscription is billed.

interval_count.description: The number of intervals between subscription billings.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: Represents a user's subscription to a product.

id.description: Unique identifier for the subscription (from Stripe).

userId.description: The ID of the user this subscription belongs to.

priceId.description: The ID of the price for this subscription.

productId.description: The ID of the product for this subscription.

cancel_at_period_end.description: If true, the subscription will cancel at the end of the current period.

created.description: Timestamp of when the subscription was created.

current_period_start.description: Start of the current billing period.

current_period_end.description: End of the current billing period.

CheckoutSession.title: CheckoutSession
CheckoutSession.description: Represents a Stripe Checkout session for a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the checkout session (from Stripe).

userId.description: The ID of the user this session belongs to.

priceId.description: The ID of the price being purchased.

success_url.description: The URL to redirect to on successful purchase.

cancel_url.description: The URL to redirect to if the purchase is canceled.

url.description: The URL of the Stripe Checkout page.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and scalability. User profiles are stored in `/users/{userId}`, enabling path-based ownership.  Workplace exams, equipment exams, documents, schedules, and training records are stored as subcollections of the user profile (e.g., `/users/{userId}/workplaceExams/{workplaceExamId}`), which clearly defines the relationship between a user and their data, and enables simple security rules. This direct path-based ownership avoids the need for complex `get()` calls in security rules, thus enforcing Authorization Independence (CRITICAL). This structure supports secure `list` operations (QAPs) by ensuring that listing a user's data only requires access to the user's specific subcollection. Subcollections provide a natural scoping mechanism for data access.
